review_corrections.problem: The initial feedback placement counted established response errors as construction failures.
review_corrections.evidence: response-before.log fails on the intermediate implementation; the negative guard now passes. This is a correction caught during this batch, not an original-baseline failure.
review_corrections.repair: Move construction success/error feedback into shared TsoStream.open_and_request, before reading the first response; remove duplicate caller feedback. Failed fallback streams retire their selected backup.

review_corrections.problem: An old failed-metadata fixture advertised an accepted new leader rather than failing membership.
review_corrections.repair: Fail GetMembers itself and retain every live-stream reuse assertion. Native broad run initially had 280 passes and that one stale-stimulus failure; the corrected final suite passes.

repairs: Both clients consume one native failure-window and route identity owner; only enabled forwarding admits a healthy backup after six eligible construction errors. Unavailable, DeadlineExceeded and server Canceled count; mixed windows, PermissionDenied, caller timeout/cancellation and retired routes cannot authorize forwarding.

Explicit follower proxy remains independent of ordinary forwarding. Healthy fallback streams retain physical endpoint and logical-primary metadata; recovery and accepted membership retire obsolete routes.

Unavailable/DeadlineExceeded GetClusterInfo observations retain the previously accepted provider instead of blocking timestamp fallback. Initial discovery still needs valid evidence; keyspace changes clear the accepted route.
Native and adapter wire consumers share construction-phase feedback; response-body errors and EOF do not enable connection fallback. Existing joined discovery and request cancellation own shutdown.
